entities.name: Nuriye Ulviye Mevlan Civelek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nuriye Ulviye Mevlan Civelek was a Turkish women's rights advocate, suffragist, journalist and founder of the first feminist women's magazine and Muslim women's rights organization in Turkey. The magazine was the first to publish a photograph of a Muslim woman.
